statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116310 (PostgreSQL COPY error context uses freed field storage) affects only PostgreSQL 17 and 18. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116310/, says versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected and lists 18.7 and 17.12 as the only fixed releases, and the CVE record, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116310, lists only major versions 17 and 18 as affected. The flaw is in COPY FROM error reporting after a conversion error that the ON_ERROR option ignored or set to null. The fix, https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/4d93c03843fb29ae5878716eceb8c6520d9f4376, clears the stale column pointers in src/backend/commands/copyfromparse.c and says it is back-patched to version 17, where ON_ERROR was introduced. At every PostgreSQL 16 release this owner publishes (REL_16_13 through REL_16_16), COPY has no ON_ERROR option and any conversion error ends the COPY; see for example https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_16_16/src/backend/commands/copy.c and https://github.com/postgres/postgres/blob/REL_16_16/src/backend/commands/copyfromparse.c. The postgres server binary in every published DHI postgresql16 build for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, reports its 16.x release and does not contain the "skipped due to data type incompatibility" message that COPY ON_ERROR reports, which the postgresql17 17.12-r0 server binary does contain on both architectures. None of the Alpine patches applied in the 16.16-r0 APKBUILD touch COPY. The 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, do not list this CVE. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 secfixes list CVE-2026-116310, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, but upstream's own advisory places PostgreSQL 16 outside the affected range.

statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116310, a use after free in COPY FROM error reporting after an ignored or nullified conversion error, in 17.12. Only major versions 17 and 18 are affected; 17 releases before 17.12 are affected and versions before PostgreSQL 17 are not (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116310/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116310). The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
